name: activate_skill
description: Add a listed skill to the active skill set for this turn. Its prompt and tools merge into the current turn; multiple active skills are equal peers regardless of activation order. Activate only when a listed skill clearly and materially improves the user's task — never for generic work, loose keyword overlap, or routine code/file/terminal investigation alone. Use `list_skills` to find candidates when a concrete specialized need exists or the user asks. Unloads automatically after the turn.

name.description: Exact name of the skill to activate.
